text: English spelling is unreliable, so dictionaries describe sounds with phonetic symbols. You are not asked to transcribe, only to recognise the common symbols and hear the contrasts Nepali does not make. Theta, in think, often becomes an aspirated t: tink. Eth, in this, becomes a hard d: dis. V becomes w: wery. Z becomes j: joo. The vowel of bad drifts to bed. Bird gets a full r: burd. And the schwa, the weak vowel in about and teacher, disappears into a full vowel.
